Not one currently but have been watching the round for a while. What are your thoughts on it? Relative to 5.56 and 7.62 NATO as well as 6.8SPC if you have the experience with any or all of those.

Thanks in advance.

I LOVE the Grendel round. I went to the range yesterday and put close to 300 rounds through her, and couldn't be happier with it. The reason I think the 6.5 Grendel is the best overall round for the AR15 platform is that: 

1. You can build your dream lower, then swap out the upper for different rounds
2. You get a supersonic bullet that can go WELL past the 1000yrd mark. It REALLY shines past the 400yrd mark
3. You get .308 Ballistics which makes hunting more humane, as well as capable of taking down big game. I've heard of people taking down bull elks at 800yrds fairly effectively.

I really wished the Military picked up this round. There's nothing but great things to say about it....and it'll lower my price per round cost greatly, LOL right now, it's still about $1 per round for Hornady SST 123gr so it can get expensive to shoot. Right now I have a bunch of Wolf Steel ammo which was right about $0.40 per round, which is still kind of costly, but it works at the range.
The only thing different for a 6.5 Grendel build is the Bolt, Barrel, and Magazines. Everything else stays the same
